svg.title: The page revisions on the nine-task set, each beside the page it would replace
svg.desc: The page revisions on the nine-task set, each beside the page it would replace. Hollow ring: the page in use (or without a page); filled dot: the revised page, drawn over the ring where the two meet; two ticks on a dashed line: one setup run twice side by side. Each pair ran side by side, task by task, on the same day or days, except the Fable 5.2 pairs, each launched as two whole runs minutes apart on the same day, one whole run after the other: 29–30 September, 5 October and 12–13 November 2026. Fable 5.1 low, the 15 September page → the 29 September page: 97 → 98 (+1.2, level within noise), $24.02 → $24.42; promoted 6 October; held-out set 98 → 98; replaced 7 October. Fable 5.1 medium, the 15 September page → the 29 September page: 96 → 96 (+0.6, level within noise), $25.48 → $25.43, agents 1 → 0; promoted 6 October; the same page as Fable 5.1 low; replaced 7 October. Opus 5.5 medium, the revised 22 September page → the 29 September page: 98 → 97 (−0.4, level within noise), $10.88 → $10.42; promoted 6 October; held-out set 97, no control run; replaced 7 October. Opus 5.5 high, the revised 22 September page → the 29 September page: 97 → 97 (−0.7, level within noise), $14.19 → $13.55; promoted 6 October; held-out set 98 → 98; Review rerun 90 → 100; replaced 7 October. Opus 5.5 max, the revised 22 September page → the 29 September page: 95 → 92 (−3.7, worse, just past the 3-point rule), $50.69 → $50.34; promoted 6 October; after reruns, page in use first: Migrate 57 → 57; Wide audit 80 → 78, then 78 → 78; replaced 7 October. Opus 5 high, the 15 September page → the 29 September page: 95 → 92 (−3.5, worse, just past the 3-point rule), $28.23 → $33.02; not promoted; its Wide audit drop repeated: 72 → 48. Opus 5 high, the 15 September page → the 30 September page: 96 → 97 (+0.8, level within noise), $29.12 → $32.21; not promoted; Migrate rerun: 100 → 86; Opus 5 keeps the 15 September page. Sonnet 5.5 high, without a page → the Opus 5.5 page of 29 September: 92 → 96 (+3.4, better, just past the 3-point rule), $5.19 → $8.38; runs without a page; held-out set, two runs each: 97.9 and 97.9 without the page → 97.9 and 97.9 with it. Sonnet 5.5 max, without a page → the Opus 5.5 page of 29 September: 89 → 97 (+8.0, better), $31.78 → $37.96; not a seat; held-out set 96 without the page → 98 with it. Opus 5 max, the Opus 5 page of 15 September, run twice side by side: 95.9 and 96.8, 0.9 points apart, $37.17 and $36.73. Sonnet 5 max, the Opus 5 page of 15 September, run twice side by side: 90.7 and 90.1, 0.5 points apart, $26.45 and $57.37, agents 0 and 5. Opus 5.5 medium, the Opus 5 page of 15 September, run twice side by side: 92.5 and 95.2, 2.7 points apart, $10.81 and $10.34. Opus 5.5 high, the Opus 5 page of 15 September, run twice side by side: 94.4 and 95.7, 1.4 points apart, $13.31 and $13.56. Opus 5.5 max, the Opus 5 page of 15 September, run twice side by side: 88.4 and 88.7, 0.3 points apart, $85.22 and $87.40, agents 9 and 9. Fable 5.2 low, without a page → the 12 November page: 96 → 95 (−1.1, level within noise), $21.15 → $22.33; the page kept; held-out set 96 → 98, same day. Fable 5.2 low, the 12 November page → the 13 November page: 94 → 97 (+2.4, level within noise), $24.52 → $24.38; promoted 13 November; held-out set 95 → 100; the first run at 100. Noise: one setup run twice moved by up to 2.7 points (the last group), so a gap of 3 points or less is level within noise; gaps come from the unrounded means. One fresh session per task, one run per cell. Numbers read page in use → revised page; a setup run twice gives its two scores and the points between them, read from the unrounded means. Runs on different days moved up to 4.2. The 29 September pages were promoted on 6 October after the held-out set showed no loss; the 7 October pages replaced them on 7 October and were measured on the held-out set only, not on these nine tasks. The tuned Fable 5.2 page of 13 November was promoted on 13 November, after the held-out set showed it passing every check (100 against 95).
